label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated bread or food provision, possibly a gathering in the great hall associated with the eighteen-hundred lighting inspection. Baker supplied bread to innkeeper; innkeeper sought wheat or hay, freight sought miller, and builder discussed a shortage and forty-six hay bales. Secretary knowingly arranged the inspection appointment, but there is no clear evidence she knows of any concealed gathering. The exact purpose, and whether the inspection is a pretext, remain uncertain.
